## 🔍 Code Review Guidelines

### For Reviewers
Please check the following during review:
- [ ] Code follows project style guidelines
- [ ] Code is well-documented and commented
- [ ] Changes are covered by tests
- [ ] No security vulnerabilities introduced
- [ ] Performance impact is acceptable
- [ ] Breaking changes are properly documented
- [ ] Database migrations are safe (if applicable)

### Architecture Review (if applicable)
- [ ] Follows DDD/Clean Architecture principles
- [ ] Proper separation of concerns
- [ ] Dependencies flow in the correct direction
- [ ] Domain logic is pure and testable
- [ ] Infrastructure concerns are isolated
